messages:
Amanda: FYI we're getting a surge of Dedicated allocation failures for customers pinned to us-central pools — multiple tickets opened with 429s + placement_fail errors. Customers: BrightMaps, AtlasHealth, and one enterprise POC. Need triage and mitigation.

Ben: Acknowledged. Can you paste one of the error payloads and the pool name? Also which autoscaler group?

Amanda: Pool header: x-dedicated-pool: us-central-hotspot
Sample curl that reproduces:```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'x-dedicated-pool: us-central-hotspot' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4x-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Response:```json
{
  "error":"allocation_failed",
  "reason":"placement_fail: no capacity in requested region; queued:32",
  "code":429
}
```

infra-bot: Telemetry snapshot for pool us-central-hotspot at 2026-03-17T18:10:32Z:
```
pool: us-central-hotspot
total_gpus: 120
allocated_gpus: 120
pending_queue: 32
avg_placement_latency_ms: 980
autoscaler_state: backoff(3m)
recent_evictions: 4
```

Carlos: Autoscaler is backing off because cloud provider returned QUOTA_EXCEEDED on instance create. We have no spare quota in us-central for A100s. Confirmed via cloud-ops dashboard.

Dana: Oncall checking quota now. If quota increase takes too long, propose temporary routing to us-west2-dedicated (compatible VM types) for affected customers. Can we enable cross-region fallback for customers marked "failover-ok"?

Ben: Steps to gather logs / repro:
1) kubectl -n dedicated logs deploy/placer --since=1h | grep placement_fail
2) kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler --since=30m | tail -n 100
3) curl telemetry API /internal/pool/us-central-hotspot/stats
Paste any placement_fail lines you see.

Emily: I'm compiling the customer tickets. Two customers reported billing spikes due to client retries (exponential backoff not kicking in). Need to advise them to enable 429-backoff client side ASAP.

Amanda: Repro steps I used above are in the ticket. Also saw this in placer logs:```
2026-03-17T18:08:12Z [placer] WARN placement_fail tenant=brightmaps reason="no compatible host" trace=abc123
2026-03-17T18:09:01Z [placer] INFO queued_request tenant=atlashealth qpos=14
```

ops-oncall: I've started a manual rebalance: triggering scale-up in us-west2 and moving idle reservations. Attempted GCE request but got: "quotaExceeded: resource 'acceleratorType'". Opening cloud support ticket. If provider delays, we can flip routing.

infra-bot: Created cloud support ticket: CLOUD-REQ-998712 requesting temporary A100 quota bump for project redwood-prod in us-central. ETA: TBD.

Carlos: Quick mitigation plan:
- Short term: Enable routing fallback for customers with failover-ok flag to us-west2 (config flag: allow_regional_fallback=true) — 5–10 min rollout.
- Mid term: Request quota bump + redistribute reserved pools across regions.
- Long term: Add predictive replenishment to autoscaler to pre-empt regional hotspotting.

Dana: I'm pushing the routing change now to canary 10% customers for 2 customers (BrightMaps, AtlasHealth). Will watch metrics.

Ben: When you flip routing, also set a soft quota limit in us-west2 to avoid noisy-neighbor thrash. Use: router config -> max_concurrent_per_pool=200.

Emily: Notifying sales & PM for impacted POCs. Drafted customer message and queued for review.

Amanda: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If cloud support confirms quota bump, mark here and we'll start rebalancing back to us-central. :pray:
